notes: Not run in a browser. Builders may not run next dev/build/start. Verified with tsc (the whole tree is clean now), eslint on my files (clean), and check-manifest OK (74 warnings, none new in my areas).

Budget estimate (TS transpile + gzip, unminified): about +1.1 KB gz was added to first-load modules (about-pillars, journey-chart, journey-experience, jack-compass, stack, carousel), while JourneyVoyage (~3.7 KB) and use-frame-sequence (~1 KB) left the first load because the voyage is now React.lazy. Expected net is about −3 KB gz first-load JS. No new CSS utilities and app/p3/world-pirates.css is unchanged, so render-blocking CSS adds ≈ 0. New lazy chunks: compass toy ≈ 3.3 KB gz, coin moon ≈ 1.4 KB gz (both pre-minify estimates).
No new strings. Copy keys used: about.philosophy.summary, toy.compass.label, egg.hunt.hint.pc-coin (the hotspot's aria-label), egg.hunt.hint.pc-parley. All already exist as proposed/unsigned.

The 'parley?' marginal uses full brass (5.3:1 on the pirates canvas) at 16 px Pirata, desktop only, aria-hidden. A 70% 'faint' brass would be 3.2:1, below AA. 'Faint' is now carried by its size and place only.

The About entrances (DEFAULT entry spin, ALT bearing sweep) now ask the spotlight as time star 'B08-compass'. It is not a declared beat and carries no data-beat. The B08 scrub owns the band, so the entrance often skips to static on desktop, and the B08-invite twitch then plays on idle. Phones and tablets enter as before.

B09 (about-end marker) is tagged for geometry but not registered with the spotlight at runtime: registering it would make the B08 invite wait whenever the compass is centred. B10 and B11 stay unregistered, as before.

Taste calls for P3-11: the at-rest L19/L20 loops play under the step caption, which sits on the calm-bottom veil (the old SM-4 rule 'never over moving media' predates the Phase-3 living loops). The coin sweep is a moving moonlight band: gold → skeleton → gold as it passes.

Phones: no visual change. The DOM differs: the journey head is now rendered inside JourneyExperience in the same order; the carousel's tablist moved to the tab layer so the coin's hotspot is never inside a tablist; the philosophy note is wrapped in details.
Nothing was needed in assets/p3/pirates: every sprite is code.
